signupRules.title: Sign-up rules
signupRules.intro: Rules decide who may create an account with Google, and which spaces a new account joins. Grants apply only when an account is created: editing a rule later adds or removes nobody.
signupRules.googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured on this server (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET). The rules still add invited accounts to their spaces.
signupRules.allowGoogle: Allow new accounts via Google for matching addresses
signupRules.allowGoogleHint: Existing accounts can always sign in. An address with a pending invitation can join with Google even without a rule.

preview.domain: Admits every address at {{value}}, but not at its subdomains.
preview.wildcard: Admits every address at {{value}} and at any subdomain of it.

problem.empty: Every rule needs a domain or address.
problem.whitespace: A pattern cannot contain spaces, so this matches nobody.
problem.address_wildcard: Wildcards are not supported inside an address, so this matches nobody.
problem.address_incomplete: An address needs a name and a domain around the @, so this matches nobody.
problem.wildcard_no_domain: A wildcard needs a domain after it.
problem.misplaced_wildcard: A wildcard is only recognised as a leading "*.", so this matches nobody.

signupRules.empty: No rules yet: nobody can sign up with Google except invited addresses.
signupRules.invalid: Fix the highlighted rules before saving.
signupRules.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can manage sign-up rules.
